response.justification: The candidate is a clearly experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some systems programming, but his profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirement: deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation. His professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015; his systems-level work since has been in DLang, and his recent years are TypeScript/Node.js product engineering. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL practice, MQTT, industrial protocols, or message-broker architectures at scale in C++.
strengths: Strong experience with high-performance, low-latency backend systems (async I/O, caching, millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Solid engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authorship, mentoring and workshop leadership
Broad polyglot background with some C/C++ and embedded/systems exposure (National Instruments, DLang, thesis work)
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, a decade ago) versus the role's core hands-on C++/STL requirement
No demonstrated industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443, SDL) or industrial protocol experience (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, etc.)
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack (TypeScript, React, AWS), diverging from industrial automation and on-prem platform development

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and performance-systems skills
